versions.name: Adventure Base
versions.summary: A rustic Northern Star Scouting outdoor camp on Boulder Lake Road north of Duluth, Minnesota, with five campsites, indoor facilities, and a climbing tower, used for weekend outings, Webelos programming, and high-adventure preparation.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Northern Star camp-reservation listing. Confirmed as a distinct Northern Star Scouting rustic camp on Boulder Lake Road near Duluth, separate from the nearby Camp Horace Johnson property. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; distinct from nearby Camp Horace Johnson; classified as a weekend/primitive camping property with Webelos programming; features unsurveyed.
